data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 雨夜车站的并肩伞下
data.description: 夜雨蒙蒙的学园轻轨月台，路灯在潮湿的水泥地面倒映出暖黄色的波光。诺亚身着优雅的米色风衣，长发被微风拂起。她撑着一把透明雨伞，将伞面偏向老师身侧，侧身仰望，紫罗兰眼眸在雨丝与暖光交织中泛着脉脉温情。
data.location: rainy train platform under warm streetlamps
data.action: holding transparent umbrella tilted towards viewer, gentle romantic gaze
data.lighting: golden streetlight reflection on wet rain-slick ground and umbrella
data.mood: tender and deeply romantic rainy night encounter
data.promptProse: Under the golden glow of streetlights on a rainy train platform, Ushio Noa holds a clear umbrella tilted sideways in her beige trench coat, peering with deep, romantic affection.
data.animaCaption: Noa sharing an umbrella on a rainy night platform.
